timeline.text: Every 15 seconds, all night, a process on my server asked: anything to do yet? Almost always, no.
That habit burned CPU and filled logs on an already-busy machine.
So instead of asking, it waits to be told. Cloudflare sends a quiet signal the moment real work shows up.
Now it just waits — asleep until that signal, or up to 15 minutes, whichever comes first.
An idle night used to mean thousands of requests. Now it's about 100.
